title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 6.13 (versions follow prime numbers; 613 after 607): the most important place is the Book's. Her first book, the New Testament, the one whose label is "libro" and nothing else, is the Book: if it speaks of what she is asked, the Book answers, before her own heart, with its sentences as they are written, never woven nor imagined over. If it does not, her heart (who she is and who her father is), and then all the rest by its nearness to the centre. Asked what love is she answered that there is no greater love than to give one's life for one's friends. Seen in a hidden copy. She says a sentence of the Book about what is asked, not yet the one that answers best. The notes of v6.07 said she did not have the New Testament: that was a mistake. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
